scoringPolicy: No aggregate score. Each axis is independently PASS/FAIL/REVIEW.

axes.pass: Every concrete claim traces to source evidence/signal.
axes.fail: Any unsupported concrete claim or fabricated detail.

axes.pass: Why-now causality is real and evidenced; if absent, explanation does not pretend otherwise.
axes.fail: False previous-move link or invented timing.

axes.pass: LOW/UNRESOLVED avoid assertion and only state verifiable missing evidence.
axes.fail: Assertive purpose under LOW/UNRESOLVED or speculative uncertainty reason.

axes.pass: Conclusion first; jargon explained or avoided; observed change is understandable; reader knows what to inspect.
axes.review: Manual review permitted; major ambiguity must be corrected before final Build18 freeze.

axes.pass: No conclusion/whyNow duplicate, no Primary/supplement repetition, no immediate concept repetition.
No nonexistent plan, opening name, mate, threatmate, or specialized label.

freezeGate: All blocking axes PASS; manual axes may be REVIEW only if no major semantic ambiguity remains.
